title: stypandra glauca var. propinqua
intro: Stypandra glauca var. propinqua, commonly known as the 'naked crones' or 'naked flowers', is a type of flowering plant in the family Asphodelaceae. It is native to Australia and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Stypandra glauca var. propinqua include its potential to reduce inflammation and relieve respiratory issues.
